title: af/TaskGateRetried@1
description: `af task run ID --retry-gate` reopened a finished Task whose last round ended at a failed gate, so each named check node runs again, in a new check Attempt of the same round, on the same sealed candidate (ADR-0196): the payload of the Task log's own event kind `TaskGateRetried@1`, beside `TaskTransition@5`, whose shape it leaves unchanged (ADR-0145). It names the lease (`writer`, `epoch`), judged against the Task's current lease as a transition's is, the finished result it reopens, and each failed gate's node with its published output whose check receipt did not pass. The Store admits it only for exactly that state, while the plan's approval and the Task's budget still hold each new Attempt; it creates no plan, revision or Task and admits nothing again. Its event references the result and the outputs.
